title: Create a fizzbuzz command-line program
spec: The repository is empty. Create `fizzbuzz.py`, runnable as `python3 fizzbuzz.py N`, which prints the numbers 1..N one per line, replacing multiples of 3 with Fizz, multiples of 5 with Buzz and multiples of both with FizzBuzz. With a missing or non-positive-integer argument it prints a usage message to stderr and exits with status 2. Add unit tests runnable with `python3 -m unittest -q`.
acceptance: `python3 fizzbuzz.py 15` prints the standard 15 fizzbuzz lines
invalid input exits 2 with a message on stderr
